items.detail: Five domains under spec/: signal definitions, dimensions, samples, evaluations and assertions. task check validates them.
items.label: The five nouns are specified in ESS

items.detail: generated/thalamus-model and generated/spec-types come from spec/ through ess; task check fails when they drift.
items.label: The Rust model is generated from the specification

items.detail: The thalamus binary parses its six subcommands (sample, eval, show, compare, rollup, flaps), and all six are implemented.
items.label: A usage error exits 64, never a verdict code

items.detail: A conformance harness runs every synthesised scenario of the definition and dimension domains.
items.label: Definition and dimension scenarios pass

items.detail: Samples, evaluations and assertions join the harness under task check.
items.label: Every synthesised conformance scenario passes

items.detail: Tests against both generated crates hold the tagged reading, and a validator holds the unit grammar ESS cannot state.
items.label: An unknown reading carries no value; a unit is UCUM

items.detail: On every push and every pull request, through .github/workflows/check.yml.
items.label: CI runs task check

items.detail: thalamus-core grades a reading against a baseline onto the ladder; an unknown reading is never OK.
items.label: One verdict, score and reason per reading

items.detail: A baseline older than its series is UNKNOWN.
items.label: Offset, pooled, higher-of, lower-of and fixed baselines

items.detail: thalamus-core settles a change after k agreeing evaluations (k_crit for CRIT); WARN clears after m OK evaluations, never on N/A or UNKNOWN.
items.label: Persistence settles verdict changes

items.detail: Computed from stored samples; a missing week or too few samples is UNKNOWN, never a median of less.
items.label: Same-slot median and rolling median baselines

items.detail: Colour ladders, detector exits and blocking gate exits, by the table in evaluation.mapping; na is UNKNOWN, never green.
items.label: Other producers' vocabularies map onto the ladder

items.detail: Its finding count against a fixed baseline, by the rule fixed_warn_only; no count printed is UNKNOWN.
items.label: An advisory gate grades WARN, never CRIT

items.detail: Only Active definitions whose dimensions are registered are sampled.
items.label: Definitions and the dimension registry load and validate

items.detail: One append-only stream per instance, on the File or SQLite provider.
items.label: Samples and evaluations persist in Eventlog

items.detail: The service samples the definition as Active again and records the unmute.
items.label: An expired mute ends by itself

items.detail: With the adapter trait every source implements and a recorded double for tests.
items.label: One read-only Connectors client for every source

items.detail: PromQL reads become typed readings; a ratio is a decimal with unit 1, NaN is unknown.
items.label: Prometheus

items.detail: LogQL metric queries.
items.label: Loki

items.detail: NULL and unparseable cells are unknown, never 0.
items.label: SQL

items.detail: Object counts as instant samples with source-only dimensions.
items.label: Kubernetes

items.detail: GitLab-hosted repository records as count and ratio samples; an unfinished page walk is a lower bound.
items.label: Git hosting

items.detail: The availability of one Connectors read operation.
items.label: HTTP probe

items.detail: This machine's CPU use, memory use, disk space and CPU temperature, read when sampled.
items.label: Host collector

items.detail: A pass over every source kind yields only ladder verdicts and exits with the worst one.
items.label: One vocabulary across every source

items.detail: One sample per series of every Active definition of an instance.
items.label: thalamus sample

items.detail: eval grades stored samples once per definition revision; show exits with the worst current verdict.
items.label: thalamus eval and thalamus show

items.detail: Answers from stored samples.
items.label: thalamus compare --vs <offset>

items.detail: One rollup per series per UTC day, written by thalamus rollup for a closed day and by the service after each UTC midnight; a re-run writes nothing.
items.label: thalamus rollup

items.detail: Measures raw and settled verdict changes per family and series-day over stored evaluations, so k and m can be fixed per family.
items.label: thalamus flaps

items.detail: The scheduler in thalamus-service owns sampling; a missed slot is an unknown sample.
items.label: Each Active definition is sampled on its cadence

items.detail: A verdict change that persisted is recorded and emitted.
items.label: Settled transitions as CloudEvents

items.detail: Served by thalamus-service, with dashboard and alert-rule export for Prometheus and Loki definitions. Planned in epic:views-and-exports.
items.label: Heatmap, sparklines, week vs week, before/after a deploy, live

items.detail: A release, a merge request, a test run or a controller asks whether named signals stayed within baseline. Planned in epic:assertions-and-integrations.
items.label: thalamus assert

items.detail: Each fact cites the evaluation that produced it; cortex never receives raw samples. Planned in epic:assertions-and-integrations.
items.label: Transitions and rollups reach cortex as facts

items.detail: Finished cases become samples; a release-day run carries signal assertions. Planned in epic:assertions-and-integrations.
items.label: Test runs, both directions
